title: Agent API Keys
description: Global keys for external LLM / MCP clients. Point them at /mcp or /tools and send Authorization: Bearer <key>.
expandedDescription: These keys are not scoped to a mailbox: any client presenting one over Authorization: Bearer <key> can call the agent tools exposed at /mcp and /tools. Keep them secret — anyone holding a key acts as this account.
empty: No agent API keys yet. Create one to connect an external LLM or MCP client.
createKeyScopeHint: Keys created here always carry the full `all` scope — the external gateway has no per-tool allow-list yet.
createdSaveNow: This is the only time the full key is shown. Copy it into your client's configuration now.
createdWarning: You will not be able to see this key again. If you lose it, revoke this key and create a new one.
revokeConfirmSuffix: ? This takes effect immediately — any external LLM or MCP client still using this key will start receiving 401 responses.
loadFailed: Failed to load agent API keys
createFailed: Failed to create the API key
revokeFailed: Failed to revoke the API key
